body:
Adds `research/scenario-twin`: importance-sampling analysis of estimating a real failure probability from a digital twin whose scenario generator has the wrong width.

- Exact reweighted variance, finite iff s² > 1/2; a 0.6× narrow generator reports zero failures in all simulated runs (real P = 1.2e-3)
- Optimal width ≈ 1.05·a, 38× fewer runs than plain Monte Carlo in the worked braking case
- Negative result: a defensive real-prior mixture is finite but no better than plain Monte Carlo
- 10 tests, results in `experiments/results.txt`; README and `site/projects.json` updated, `python site/build.py` prints ok

Stylised and preliminary (1-D Gaussian scenarios, no robot data).
